seed_ledger.name: Circe Energy Data Centers E. Monahans Campus (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Circe's 1,950-acre I-20 campus uses behind-the-meter Cummins reciprocating gensets (2 GW ordered, deliveries 2026-2030); Circe says fuel supply is arranged but no source names a pipeline, supplier, tap or length. Trade press (DCD, Yahoo release, mgrid, constructionreviewonline) and Circe's site name none. A TCEQ notice for Monahans (178462) belongs to Luminant, not Circe. Not checked successfully: FERC, Railroad Commission T-4, EIA workbook showed nothing naming the site. Searches run: 5. Sources: DCD (2 GW gas capacity, no pipe), Circe site (no supply detail), TCEQ notices (other company), Cleanview (unrelated 18 MW).

evidence.note: Cummins 2 GW behind-the-meter gas gensets; no pipeline named

seed_ledger.name: Crusoe-Blue Energy data center power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Blue Energy filed NRC construction permit Part 1 on 2026-09-15; two GE 7HA.02 turbines (about 1 GW) run on gas from about 2028-2030 then SMRs, powering a nearby Crusoe campus. Reports and the roughly 300-page environmental report summary name no lateral, operator, length or air permit. Site sits 2-5 km from NGPL, Transco and Tennessee lines, so a short tap is likely but unsourced. Searches run: 5. Sources: NRC-filing coverage (constructionreviewonline, NEI, Yahoo; no pipe), NGI and Williams hits (unrelated Transco compression), RRC/TCEQ searches (nothing).

evidence.note: Gas-first 2.5 GW hybrid at Port of Victoria for Crusoe; no lateral named

seed_ledger.name: Data City Energy Center (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Energy Abundance's 5 GW Data City near Laredo is announced behind-the-meter, first phase 300 MW fueled by Texas-produced gas, later hydrogen; DCD says first phase not before 2028. No pipeline, supplier or tap named in the press release, DCD, Connect CRE, Cleanview, Aterio or trackers; nothing found from Webb County, FERC or RRC. Nearest GGIT line is Tejas P0258 at 6 km, unsourced. Searches run: 5. Sources: DCD and company release (gas only generic), trackers (rumored, unconfirmed).

evidence.note: Behind-the-meter, Texas gas initially; no pipeline named
